# toolkit (fixture)

## Setup

Install local tools at `C:/Users/someone/tools/` before running anything
else — that path is this machine's layout, not a portable one.

## Note

The docs mirror is published at `https://example.com` and needs no local
setup; a URL scheme is not a drive letter.
